maria-privacy: Heads up — received a SAR asking for full account erasure including generated embeddings and any derived artefacts. Need a short, actionable checklist so ops can safely remove everything and we can attest back to the user. Also: were there any RBAC changes this week that might have exposed embeddings? cc @sam-engsec @elle-sre @oliver-legal

sam-engsec: TL;DR: main risks are S3 object versions + snapshots + cached KV entries. Our embeddings bucket uses CMK alias/redwood-embeddings-prod. Deleting objects alone won't remove prior versions or older snapshots. Also watch KMS grants. I'll sketch steps below.

sam-engsec: Checklist (draft):
- 1) Call internal purge API: POST /internal/embeddings/purge {"user_id": "<UID>"} to enqueue canonical removal and write an audit entry.
- 2) Verify DB indexes cleared (embeddings_index entries for user).
- 3) S3: list object versions for prefix user/<UID> and delete all versions: `aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-embeddings-prod --prefix user/<UID>` then `aws s3api delete-object --bucket ... --key ... --version-id ...`
- 4) Trigger snapshot GC for embeddings (snapshot-gc job). If GC is manual, request ops-run: `./bin/snapshot-gc --target=embeddings --prefix=user/<UID> --confirm`
- 5) Revoke any temporary KMS grants for that UID or related service principals: `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <id>` and remove KMS key policies that allowed broad decrypts.
- 6) Invalidate KV cache / runtime caches: call purge endpoint on runtime nodes and confirm KV cache misses.
- 7) Collect audit artifacts: CloudTrail entries, KMS grant records, purge job log, snapshot GC confirmation, and S3 delete-version receipts.
- 8) Return attestation to legal: include timestamps + hashes of deleted object keys (if retained in evidence bundle) or notes that snapshots were purged.

elle-sre: Quick note — we did an RBAC tweak Tuesday where `support_readonly` got temporary s3:GetObject on `redwood-embeddings-prod` for a debugging window (approx 2026-11-03T09:10Z -> 2026-11-03T13:00Z). That was rolled back yesterday at ~2026-11-04T08:22Z. We must audit which principals accessed the prefix during that window. I'll query CloudTrail.

jonathan-devex: Use the internal purge API first — it handles most of the DB/index + runtime-cache work automatically and posts a job event to `embedding-purge` queue. If the job errors (e.g., snapshot locks), it will surface a runbook link in the job logs.

oliver-legal: From legal: deletion must include backups/snapshots unless a retention exception is opened. If you think we need to hold data for investigation, file a retention-exception ASAP and give a clear rationale. Otherwise proceed with deletion flow and we'll request attestation for SAR response within 30 days. If there was a potential access by support team, preserve evidence; do not scrub before legal confirms.

maria-privacy: Proposed owners: Sam = run purge + collect immediate logs; Elle = CloudTrail + list principals; SRE = snapshot GC (or approve); Legal = decide if retention exception needed. I'll update SR-4921 with these owners. Anyone object?

sam-engsec: I'll kick off the purge now and attach job id. Also will collect KMS grant list and revoke any active grants tied to debugging. One caution — do NOT rotate the embeddings CMK until legal confirms, because rotation could complicate late-stage key recovery for evidence.

elle-sre: I'll run the CloudTrail query and post results here. Quick commands I'll run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=redwood-embeddings-prod --start-time 2026-11-03T09:00:00Z --end-time 2026-11-04T09:00:00Z` and `jq` the principals.

privacy-bot: Reminder: DSAR playbook v2 now includes a SnapshotGC checkbox and KMS-grant-revoke step. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/privacy/dsar-playbook — please update the ticket with the proof artifacts. :white_check_mark:

maria-privacy: Thanks. I'll hold off on attestation until we confirm no retention exception. If legal opens a hold, we'll pause destructive steps and instead capture forensic images (S3 object copies, KMS grant history, snapshot list) under evidence bucket. Ticket: SR-4921 updated.

oliver-legal: If CloudTrail shows any unauthorized read of user content, escalate to incident response and preserve chain-of-custody for affected artifacts. Also note: we may need to send a supplemental notice to the user if an unauthorized access is confirmed.

sam-engsec: Action items I'll post here as soon as purge job id is created. Will also add a short shell snippet for safe deletion in ops runbook.

maria-privacy: Appreciate it. Let's sync if anything unusual shows up. :handshake:
